findings.summary: terraform/README.md and the header comment of terraform/ci-access/outputs.tf still say the workflows read the role ARNs from repository variables, which the human's ruling of 2026-11-15 replaced with secrets.
The next-day snapshot check filters on the project tag, so it cannot show a snapshot of the untagged root volume; an unfiltered list compared against the root volume id would.
The plan role's secret-read probe gets the same error code from the explicit deny and from a missing allow, so it shows the read is refused but not which statement refused it.
The checklist names README sections by file and heading rather than linking them, so a renamed heading would leave a stale pointer.
Three result rows settle the provider argument-name VERIFY items for their parts without naming them, while the state part's row does.
There is no make target for the kit's secret scanner, so roles run the script directly.

The findings file is written once per issue before the summary, but a two-stage issue like this one stays open for the human's run, and the procedure does not say where findings from the stage (b) re-check go.
